free_tier_limits: 100 requests/day; up to 3 symbols per stock-price request, 1 symbol per intraday request, and 2 articles per news request; 1 month each of intraday and EOD history.
rate_limits: Daily quotas: Free 100; Basic 2,500; Standard 10,000; Pro 25,000; Pro 50K 50,000 requests. A separate rolling 60-second limit applies; its unstated numeric cap is reported in X-RateLimit-Limit. Exceeding it returns HTTP 429.
resolution_notes: free_tier_limits: ORIGINAL "unknown" is incorrect.
